svg.title: Hippocampal nuclei, CA1 layer programs and inhibitory clusters
svg.desc: Seurat classification across wild-type and Satb2 conditional knockout mice. A common stem branches into five major cell types. The excitatory branch expands into CA1 and prosubiculum cluster markers and their layer assignments. The inhibitory branch shows all original clusters with C6 divided into three SST subclusters. Each terminal cluster has its own color. Superficial and deep layer markers are ranked by paired wild-type expression. Branch widths are schematic. Hover over a marker or ribbon to read the original cluster identifier.
